scope: Development regression qualification using the shipped browser content script/styles and stateless HTTP transport with isolated host/API fixtures. No live database changes, prover execution or provider calls.
findings: The batch launcher previously gave only a generic activity indicator during source/mirror preparation and waited for worker completion before displaying a batch.
The displayed button recomputed its eligible target set on click and the batch dispatcher silently returned for an empty set.
A disconnected or ambiguous request did not retain a batch-level retry intent after its two immediate transport attempts.

behavior.intent: Capture the displayed target set and project synchronously; retain one browser intent per project while this tab remains open.
behavior.preparation: Show preparing or waiting state immediately; publish immutable source through SQL before executable admission. Source/document changes before submission require an explicit new request.
behavior.admission: Prefer: respond-async on /formalize/all and /stub/all returns HTTP 202 with the original SQL command receipt without observing a worker.
behavior.retry: Freeze destination, JSON bytes and idempotency key after preparation. Retry connection/deadline/capacity failures with exponential 1–30 second backoff; once accepted, only read its command receipt.
behavior.deadlines: Source publisher, full mirror, admission and receipt exchanges are bounded to ten seconds each. Accepted commands have no browser-imposed execution cancellation.
behavior.withdrawal: Cancel unsent preparations and explicitly rejected capacity attempts locally. Stale controls cannot discard accepted or ambiguous requests. Worker-terminal errors are displayed without automatic resubmission.
behavior.selection: Update the admission surface without replacing selected source/code; defer selected admission text updates until the range clears. Automatic results preserve the Items/Blueprint view.
behavior.authority: Only SQL admission/receipts/publications are used. Existing queue quotas, frozen source bindings and worker-side validation are unchanged.
behavior.durability_limit: Unaccepted intent exists in the open browser tab. It is not represented as database-queued before acknowledgement. Accepted work belongs to the durable SQL queue.

browser_observations: Startup outage is visible and retries into SQL acceptance without a worker.
Repeated launch produces one business POST.
Automatic receipt observations preserve source text selection.
Desktop waiting and narrow-pane queued screenshots reviewed; no overflow.
validation.release_qualification: No new production image or rollback qualification is claimed.
